decisions.reason: As an organic multi-variant extension that remained on the website through 2024, it fits the firm's announced expansion path and prior investment makes management likely to continue with it.

Although its visibility fell from a dedicated page in 2023 to a general mention in 2024, it is still close to the core salami business and sunk investments plus broad-assortment logic favor retaining it.
This very recent 2024 organic launch received its own page and supports the firm's stated push into organic lines, so management is likely to give it more time rather than withdraw it quickly.
A newly launched organic product line with several models and its own page is highly aligned with the firm's strategy, making escalation of commitment especially likely.
This recent organic salami variant is close to established competencies and publicly introduced on its own page, so management is inclined to keep it unless failure becomes unmistakable.
